payload.title: File:Hulkepholis and Goniopholis.jpg
payload.description_html:
Fig. 1. Goniopholis crassidens? (in Mr. Willett’s collection), upper surface, one fourth natural size (now Hulkepholis willetti).

Fig. 2. Under surface of same.

Fig. 2a. Tooth of Goniopholis crassidens, natural size.

Fig. 3. Upper surface of skull Goniopholis simus type specimen No. 41,098 Brit. Mus., one fourth natural size.

Fig. 4. Under surface of same, showing the palato-nares.

In figs. 2and 4: p/, palate-bone; pz, pterygoid bone; pm, palato-nares ;

Eu, median Eustachian orifice.
